title: Addendum 11: batch 2 additions - (A) name-position probe (direct H3 test) and (B) completing groups C and D for E1 / E2
written: 2026-11-05 ~22:55 EST (exact time = sha256 file mtime and git)
approved_by_user: user message 2026-11-05 ~22:40: C/D completion goes into batch 2; new item 'name-position probe (H3)' goes into batch 2, lock addendum 11 first, estimate GPU cost first.
status_at_writing: No name-position residual has ever been stored (Stage 10 stored lens ranks only; addendum 9 stored only the L63 state at name-predicting positions under the true title). Groups C and D in the Stage 11 sample have 36 and 5 papers (descriptive only under addendum 7). Batch 1 (addendum 10) is running; its results are not known.
general rules: as addendum 10: tiny-model whole-pipeline test, one real shard, then the rest; reproduction of published numbers is a HARD check (stop on failure, report); team-cluster bootstrap 2,000 draws on archived group_folds team ids; at most 3 helpers; results to the user before any document change. Batch 2 starts after batch 1 has finished.

A name-position probe.question: Is paper-specific author information present at the name positions in the middle layers in a linearly decodable form that the lenses do not read out? (H3: the middle layers hold the author in a form the lenses cannot read.)
A name-position probe.positions: the ':' position and every name-token position that PREDICTS a name token (the same position set as addendum 9: for author token t, the position whose next token is t), all authors, Stage 10 contexts (year, title, every author context as in Stage 10).
A name-position probe.GPU step: for all 9,108 papers record the residual at those positions at L32, L40, L48, L52, L56 under the true title and under false_0..false_4 (prompt + teacher-forced true author tokens, as Stage 10); the L63 target states under the true title already exist (381_stage13/raw/allTok_L63) and are reused. fp16, skip-if-exists per shard.
A name-position probe.probe: per layer and token role (initial, given_first, given_cont, surname_first, surname_cont, and the ':' / first-token run): ridge from the layer-l residual at the position to the L63 residual at the SAME position, trained on true-title rows only; author-team folds (archived), training-fold standardisation, alpha by CV on fold 0 from (0.1, 1, 10); decode the prediction with the final norm + lm_head rows of the 9,137 name token ids (addendum 9 vocabulary) and score the gold next token by log10(1/rank). Paper score = mean over its tokens of the role.
A name-position probe.title-specific signal: spec = probe(true-title residual) - mean over k = 0..4 of probe(false_k-title residual), each scored against the true gold token. Title-reuse exclusion: 5-donor rule of addendum 10 (and the false_0-only version beside it if fewer than 1,000 target + control papers remain).
A name-position probe.controls: the two permutation controls of the confirmatory E4b (gold tokens of a random other paper; of a random paper of the same field), same rng convention (default_rng(3712)), per role and layer.
A name-position probe.lens comparison: at the same positions, layers and tokens, the Stage 10 logit-lens and public J-lens title-specific signal (true minus mean of the 5 false titles, from the stored Stage 10 ranks). Stage 10 stored full-vocabulary ranks only, so the lens uses full-vocabulary ranks while the probe ranks within the 9,137 name tokens; the table states this, and the comparison is made on the sign and CI of each signal, not on its size, side by side with the probe.
A name-position probe.primary H3 contrast: per role at L40 and L48: probe title-specific signal > 0 (team CI) while the lens title-specific signal at the same layer has a CI including 0 or is smaller than the probe's; reported for surname_first first. Other layers and roles descriptive.
A name-position probe.caveat stated in advance: as l approaches 63 the probe approaches the identity map, so L52-L56 are expected to agree with the output; the H3 evidence is weighted on L32-L48.
A name-position probe.report: all roles x layers, target - control within citation bin, the addendum-7 group split on unwritten authors, controls, and the lens comparison table.
A name-position probe.hard check: (1) the true-title L63 states recomputed in this run for one shard reproduce raw/allTok_L63 (relative norm diff <= 0.05); (2) the Stage 10 lens title-specific signal used in the comparison reproduces the published Stage 10 values at L40 / L48 for the same token subset (|diff| <= 0.005).
A name-position probe.cost estimate: about 4-6 A100-80GB GPU-hours (6 conditions x about 0.7-1 h each, scaled from the addendum-9 data step: 72 shards in about 41 min for one condition and one layer); storage about 55 GB on /scratch (fp16, 5 layers x 149,999 positions x 6 conditions). Probe fitting on CPU.

B groups C and D completed for E1 / E2.papers: all R1 x strong papers (C, 511) and all R1 x fail papers (D, 34) of the Stage 10 cohort; the 36 C and 5 D papers already in the Stage 11 sample are re-used, not re-run (475 + 29 new papers).
B groups C and D completed for E1 / E2.experiments: Stage 11 E1 (tail + name patching, true -> false_0) and E2 (attention knockout) with identical code, prompts, layers and batch sizes (driver 14_groups/rerun_gpu.py, which reproduced the original bit for bit); unwritten-author analysis as addendum 7/8 with numerator / denominator split.
B groups C and D completed for E1 / E2.analysis: C - A and D - B within citation bin on unwritten authors (now with n >= 30 for C; D stays below 30 papers in total and remains descriptive under the n rule of addendum 7), C - D descriptive.
B groups C and D completed for E1 / E2.hard check: a re-run of one original Stage 11 shard through the driver reproduces the stored E1 / E2 values (as addendum 8).
B groups C and D completed for E1 / E2.cost estimate: about 0.7-0.9 A100-80GB GPU-hours (10 shards of 50 papers; measured about 115 s per shard for E1 + E2 in the addendum-8 re-runs, plus model load).
